description: This PHP source file manages the WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) configuration interface for a wireless network. It includes server-side logic for retrieving current WPS and Wi-Fi settings, validation functions, and client-side JavaScript for handling user interactions such as enabling/disabling WPS, selecting connection methods, and initiating pairing. The file also dynamically generates a user interface for adding a Wi-Fi client via WPS, with security checks and configuration options.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates the checksum of a WPS PIN to ensure it is correctly formatted and passes the checksum algorithm.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Prepares configuration data and sends an AJAX request to update WPS settings on the device.
